instruction: Like all the venmo transactions of the ongoing year to and from my roommates.
notes: Roommates and their transactions are unknown up front, so the problem uses placeholder entities (roommate-1, roommate-2; tx-roommate-1-a, tx-roommate-1-b, tx-roommate-2-a) whose ids are bound at runtime; the counts are representative and the model is extended per discovered contact/transaction. Static facts (has-relationship, email-of, transaction-with, created-on-or-after) describe the hidden database; they only become usable after the corresponding lookup: phone.search_contacts asserts (contacts-searched rel-roommate), venmo.show_transactions with user_email and min_created_at asserts (transactions-listed e d), and like_transaction requires both plus created-on-or-after so that out-of-year transactions (tx-roommate-1-old) can never be liked, mirroring the evaluation's year filter. Transaction records are declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task's precondition is literally the goal conjunction (no parameters, since complete_task takes no answer). show_transactions with user_email covers both directions (to and from). phone.get_current_date_and_time gates knowledge of the year-start date (2023-01-01). Login usernames come from supervisor.show_profile (phone_number for phone, email for venmo).
